title: Custom American Football with Patriotic Flag Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom Galaxy Football Flag Comforter by Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this high-quality bedding features a vibrant sports design that brings the energy of the game into your home decor. Customizable with text options, this comforter is designed to deliver both modern style and exceptional comfort.

Key Features

  • Customized Design: Features up to two text inputs for names, numbers, or custom messages to create a personalized sports keepsake.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88") beds.
  • Included Components: Set includes 1 comforter (or duvet cover) with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; quick-drying microfiber becomes fluffier with each wash.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Galaxy Football Flag
Theme Football
Pattern Galaxy
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
